name: up-next
title: Up Next
summary: Hold Select to play items next or last.
description: Hold Select on a song, an album or an artist while music plays. Settings > Hold Select selects what the hold does.
details: Play Next: after the current song.
Play Last: after the last song of the list.
On-The-Go: into the On-The-Go playlist, as without the patch.
Cover Flow: opens Cover Flow in the Albums list, and does Play Next in other lists. This value needs the Cover Flow patch.
notes: When no music plays, a hold of Select adds the songs to On-The-Go.
With Shuffle on, Play Next and Play Last also put the songs in the correct position.

choices.title: Play Next
choices.description: A hold of Select plays the songs directly after the current song.

choices.title: Play Last
choices.description: A hold of Select plays the songs after the last song of the list that plays now.

choices.title: On-The-Go
choices.description: A hold of Select adds the songs to On-The-Go, as without the patch.

choices.title: Cover Flow
choices.description: The default. In the Albums list, a hold of Select opens Cover Flow (only with the Cover Flow patch). In the other lists, and without the Cover Flow patch, it does Play Next.
